person: Tag names of individual people as person.
Do not include job titles unless the dataset annotation includes them as part of the name.
Person names often co-occur with organisation names in employment, reporting, or sports contexts.
location: Tag geographical places such as countries, cities, states, regions, rivers, and landmarks as location.
Location names may appear inside organisation names, but the full organisation mention should not be split if it denotes an institution.
Location is frequently confused with organisation when an institution or team is named after a place.
organisation: Tag companies, agencies, institutions, sports teams, and news agencies as organisation.
Organisation mentions often co-occur with person names and location names.
A place name should be organisation when it refers to a team, institution, company, or agency rather than a geographical place.
misc: Tag named entities that do not fit person, location, or organisation as misc.
Misc includes nationalities, events, products, works, languages, and other named categories.
Misc is weakly related to all other entity types because it is a residual category.

confusion_rules.reason: Organisation mentions often appear near person mentions in employment, reporting, and sports contexts.
Organisation names may contain place names or be confused with teams and institutions named after locations.
Location names can refer to teams or institutions, making organisation a high-risk old type.
Person mentions frequently co-occur with organisations, and context may shift between individual and institution.
Misc is a broad residual category and has weak ambiguity with person names.
Misc includes nationalities and events that can be contextually related to locations.
Misc includes products, events, and works that can be contextually related to organisations.
